name: Gladiator Beast Heraklinos (UTR)
extDescription:
"Gladiator Beast Laquari" + 2 "Gladiator Beast" monsters
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by shuffling the above cards you control into the Deck. (You do not use "Polymerization".) During either player's turn, when a Spell/Trap Card is activated: You can discard 1 card; negate the activation and destroy it. This card must remain face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Chaos Sorcerer
extDescription: Cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster from your Graveyard. Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field: banish that target. This card cannot attack during the turn you activate this effect.

name: Gravekeeper's Assailant
extDescription: If "Necrovalley" is on the field when this card declares an attack, you can select 1 face-up monster your opponent controls and change its battle position.

name: Magical Dimension
extDescription: If you control a face-up Spellcaster-Type monster: Target 1 monster you control; Tribute it, then Special Summon 1 Spellcaster-Type monster from your hand, then you can destroy 1 monster on the field.

name: Foolish Burial
extDescription: Select 1 monster from your Deck and send it to the Graveyard.

name: Beckoning Light
extDescription: Discard all the cards in your hand to the Graveyard. Then add the same number of LIGHT monsters from your Graveyard to your hand.

name: Gravekeeper's Spear Soldier
extDescription: During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent.

name: My Body as a Shield
extDescription: Activate only by paying 1500 Life Points when your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or Effect Monster's effect that would destroy a monster(s) on the field. Negate the activation of that card and destroy it.

name: Magical Stone Excavation
extDescription: Discard 2 cards, then target 1 Spell Card in your Graveyard; add it to your hand.

name: Mist Archfiend
extDescription: You can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. If you do, during the End Phase it is destroyed and you take 1000 damage.

name: Light-Imprisoning Mirror
extDescription: Negate all LIGHT monster effects activated on the field or in the Graveyard.

name: Shadow-Imprisoning Mirror
extDescription: Negate all DARK monster effects activated on the field or in the Graveyard.

name: Anti-Spell Fragrance
extDescription: Both players must Set Spell Cards before activating them, and cannot activate them until their next turn.

name: Gravekeeper's Cannonholder
extDescription: You can Tribute 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster, except "Gravekeeper's Cannonholder", to inflict 700 damage to your opponent.

name: Necrovalley
extDescription:
All Gravekeeper's monsters gain 500 ATK and DEF. Cards in either player's Graveyard cannot be banished. Cards in either player's Graveyard cannot be affected by card effects, except for their own effects.

(Red text indicates errata.)

name: Autonomous Action Unit
extDescription: Pay 1500 Life Points to target 1 monster in your opponent's Graveyard; Special Summon that target to your side of the field in face-up Attack Position, and equip it with this card. When this card leaves the field, destroy the equipped monster.

name: Anti-Spell
extDescription: Remove 2 Spell Counters on your side of the field to negate the activation of a Spell Card and destroy it.

name: Reflect Bounder
extDescription: When this face-up Attack Position card is attacked by an opponent's monster, before damage calculation, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the attacking monster's ATK. Then, destroy this card after damage calculation.

name: Mausoleum of the Emperor
extDescription: Both players can Normal Summon or Set monsters without Tributing, by paying 1000 Life Points x the number of monsters needed for the Tribute Summon.

name: Gravekeeper's Commandant
extDescription: You can discard this card to the Graveyard to add 1 "Necrovalley" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru
extDescription: During your Draw Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard, you can add this card to your hand instead of drawing, and/or send 1 "Koa'ki Meiru" monster from your hand to your Graveyard to add this card to your hand.
